title: v0.12.2
excerpt: Added 📑 MinerU 4.x servers. The MinerU document engine now works with self-hosted MinerU 4.x servers, where every document failed with a 404 because 4.x removed the old parsing interface; 3.x servers work as before, 4.x servers take a tier (flash, basic, standard or advanced) and enable_ocr in the MinerU parameters while language and model_version stay 3.x only, and images that 4.x returns inside the document text are left out of the indexed content. #32422 , Commit , #31516 🤝 Keep both changes when comparing. The Compare revision view now has a Keep both button that puts the original and the proposed text of the selected change into the proposed revision, original first, so you no longer have to pick one side. Commit 📚 Open attached knowledge from its preview. Clicking the name in the preview of an attached knowledge collection now opens that collection in the workspace, and file and link names are real links that open in a new tab. Commit 🏷️ Model ID in custom headers. Custom headers on connections and tool servers can now use {{MODEL_ID}}, which holds the ID of the model handling the chat request, the workspace model's own ID for a workspace model and each model's own ID in a multi-model chat, so downstream services can route or log usage per model. #32426 , Commit , #30006 🧾 Requested model in the audit log. Audit log entries for chat and completion requests, including the OpenAI, Ollama and Anthropic compatible endpoints, now carry a model_id field with the model the cli
